title: COVID-19 pandemic
summary: An outbreak of a new coronavirus disease in Wuhan at the end of 2019 spread through Asia and then worldwide in the first months of 2020. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern on 30 January 2020 and called it a pandemic on 11 March; it ended the emergency in May 2023. It is in the atlas as the origin of a chain that reaches Portugal in March 2020 and produces the first state of emergency under the constitution of 1976 — the only event here that begins outside Europe and changes the Portuguese state directly.
